meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按任务组建由「执行、指挥、评审」三类角色组成的 AI 团队,让它们共享同一份上下文记忆,并把讨论、辩论到形成决策的完整过程实时展示出来。
howto.when: 当任务需要多个智能体协同完成,或你要求用预设团队处理时触发,例如「请用技术决策团队评估……」「请用OPC团队构建……」等调用方式。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构的可行性
say.note: 你会看到主持人、架构师等的发言与辩论

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: 按战略分析、产品架构、工程实现三步输出

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这款产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场、财务、评审角色参与讨论并给结论

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude forms an AI team of executive, management, and review roles that share one context memory, and shows their discussion, debate, and decision process live before delivering the combined result.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs several agents working together, or when you call a preset team, such as a technical decision team or an OPC build team.

say_en.text: Use the technical decision team to assess microservice architecture
say_en.note: You will see the host and architects debate

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short videos
say_en.note: Outputs strategy, product design, then implementation

say_en.text: Use the product team to set pricing for this product
say_en.note: Market, finance, and review roles discuss and conclude
